svg.text: PDAC development trajectory from archived automated reviews
Rates are automated reviewer flags per 100 samples. They are not clinician-confirmed error rates.
A. Major flags recorded by Qwen reviewer
B. Minor flags recorded by Qwen reviewer
C. P1 flags by output section
D. P1 flags by reviewed output area
D1-D9: same 30-row subset. F2-F9: same 100-row development set; F6-F9 have no archived auto_review.py summary and are shown as NA.
The auto-review rubric changed during early iterations and no rubric hash was stored. Compare the series as historical development logs, not as a fixed-validator benchmark.
P0 was 0 in every archived Qwen review. Manual or Claude-authored follow-up reviews are excluded from these curves.
